adopted.configured_fallback_scope: Adopt all stored C, in ascending order, for UInt16 ResetFallback with bits>0 in every recognized Composite/Color/Grayscale mode, including an ActiveChannel request. This preserves the source-backed CompositeImage all-LUT Reset scope. Other fallback requests follow requested active/CompositeAll mode scope.
adopted.raw_domain: Raw canonical U8/U16/F32 and the reviewed quiet-NaN policy only. Native has no typed signed-density or intensity transfer-function state; never infer it from opaque metadata. Preserve raw samples and spatial/time/opaque metadata. Ordinary Java signed16 fixed-range Reset exceptions and calibrated-domain editing remain separately required G057/CD16/intensity-calibration work. No signed-calibrated parity claim.
adopted.canonical_native_state: Adopt current recognized native logical state, consistent with prior channel-display adoption. CompositeAll applies getter-rounded endpoints only when captured mode==Composite, including singleton Composite. Color/Grayscale keep active-C requested endpoints except configured fixed-U16 fallback. H15 Color/Gray original repeated action additionally incurs Java setupNewImage, rounded active LUT and divisor0; retain that observed difference explicitly rather than reproduce hidden processor/setup cache state. Native changes neither mode nor C as a side effect of Auto and does not manufacture that setup reset.
adopted.selection_and_empty: ActiveSelection captures full validated active geometry/attributes; known nonarea uses whole XY. WholePlane is explicit and retains Selection dependency. Empty/no-finite area refuses, including configured U16, without display/record/cycle publication. No Java sentinel or fallback substitution.
adopted.recording: One normalized native Auto record per successful admitted Auto when recording is enabled, including equal and fallback effects. Replay applies the resolved nested Set effect, never ImageJ Enhance text or a histogram; it neither restores nor advances a live cycle. Retain original record on strict replay; full explicit rebind recomputes from complete new request.
